description: E26固定结果后的全原机会费用/贡献/入场年与有限端点路径上界诊断，不构造新策略或运行账户。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
import numpy as np,pandas as pd
ROOT=Path.cwd();R26='reports/research/510300_export_order_cause_increment_v1'
R='reports/research/510300_export_score_target_gap_diagnostic_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def readj(p):return json.loads((ROOT/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
def save_new(name,obj):
    p=OUT/name;assert not p.exists(),'已存在不覆盖：'+name
    p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
assert not OUT.exists();OUT.mkdir(parents=True)
(OUT/'原账户目标口径快照.json').write_bytes((ROOT/'config/510300_existing_data_training_mandate_v1.json').read_bytes())
parentpaths=[R26+'/protocol.json',R26+'/result.json',
 R26+'/每日外需条件评分.csv',R26+'/两模型全部自然高分机会.csv',R26+'/逐年自然机会.csv',
 R26+'/原八变量与外需两列_原标签不变.parquet',R26+'/保存结果必要核对.json',
 'research/multidim_nonlinear_score_v1.py','data/reference/510300_dividends.csv',
 R+'/原账户目标口径快照.json']
parents=[{'path':p,'bytes':(ROOT/p).stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(ROOT/p)} for p in parentpaths]
p27={'study_id':'510300_EXPORT_SCORE_TARGET_GAP_DIAGNOSTIC_V1','experiment_id':'E27','registered_at':now(),
 'question':'E26高分均值变正后，固定自然机会数量、单笔贡献和原费用能否支持完整目标？',
 'previous_goal_turn_classification':'PROGRESS_E26_FIXED_EXPORT_CONDITION_COMPARISON_COMPLETED',
 'scope':'保留E26外需全部32自然机会及原控制；主期10，较早22，只解释保存结果。',
 'selection':'原固定评分/80分/正预测/自然不重叠全部事件；此前结果已见，非独立检验。',
 'year_rule':'原评分期按信号日分主/早期不变；合同次数按实际入场年另列，2026残年单列，诊断计数不等于完整风险账户周期。',
 'label_contract':'复用原10000份入/出报价、两侧佣金/最低5元及原登记日权益，精确复算已有net_event_return；不改模型标签。',
 'cost_diagnostic':'同报价零佣金和原端点原始开盘零佣金/零滑点的算术差，只解释费用。不是可执行新策略。',
 'bounded_counterfactual':'主期原10个互不重叠窗口、原端点完整持有/一次退出；事后只保留正原始含权益收益，每次起点50%NAV、可分份额、零费用、忽略ES/T+1现金/停牌等现实限制，权益全计入下一期NAV。只是此有限固定完整持有路径的宽松上界，不能推广到不同窗口或中途退出/任意策略。',
 'annualization':'242日；主期从2024首个实际交易日延至原最后退出（2026残年），所有现金日纳入日数，不将2026正标签算成2025入场。',
 'contribution':'正标签和份额、总净标签和比值与最大正标签之外其余九行均值都是事后算术诊断，非真实账户利润、不提供删样本过滤器。',
 'new_model_fits':0,'new_training_labels':0,'new_full_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,
 'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'orders_authorized':False,'goal_achieved':False,
 'parents':parents}
save_new('protocol.json',p27)
e26=readj(R26+'/result.json')
assert e26['status']=='REJECTED_FROZEN_FIXED_EXPORT_ORDER_CONDITION_NO_PRIMARY_INCREMENT'
events=pd.read_csv(ROOT/R26/'两模型全部自然高分机会.csv')
events=events[events.model=='外需十变量'].copy()
assert len(events)==32 and len(events[events.era=='2024—2025'])==10
d=pd.read_parquet(ROOT/R26/'原八变量与外需两列_原标签不变.parquet')
div=pd.read_csv(ROOT/'data/reference/510300_dividends.csv');div['record_date']=pd.to_datetime(div.record_date)
rows=[]
for r in events.itertuples(index=False):
    i=int(r.idx);a=d.iloc[i+1];b=d.iloc[i+6]
    assert str(pd.Timestamp(a.date).date())==r.entry_date and str(pd.Timestamp(b.date).date())==r.exit_date
    rawbuy=float(a.open);rawsell=float(b.open)
    buy=np.ceil(rawbuy*1.001*1000-1e-9)/1000
    sell=np.floor(rawsell*.999*1000+1e-9)/1000
    ent=float(div.loc[div.record_date.ge(a.date)&div.record_date.lt(b.date),'cash_dividend_per_share'].sum())
    paid=10000*buy+max(5.,10000*buy*.0004)
    received=10000*(sell+ent)-max(5.,10000*sell*.0004)
    net=received/paid-1
    no_comm=(sell+ent)/buy-1
    gross=(rawsell+ent)/rawbuy-1
    assert np.isclose(net,float(r.net_event_return),rtol=0,atol=1e-15)
    assert gross>=no_comm-1e-15 and no_comm>=net-1e-15
    rows.append({'idx':i,'era':r.era,'signal_date':r.signal_date,'entry_date':r.entry_date,'exit_date':r.exit_date,
      'signal_year':pd.Timestamp(r.signal_date).year,'entry_year':pd.Timestamp(r.entry_date).year,
      'saved_net5':float(r.net_event_return),'same_quotes_zero_commission_return':float(no_comm),
      'fixed_endpoints_raw_zero_cost_return':float(gross),'commission_return_drag':float(no_comm-net),
      'slippage_tick_return_drag':float(gross-no_comm),'raw_entry_open':rawbuy,'raw_exit_open':rawsell,
      'entitled_cash_dividend_per_share':ent,'original_paid_cny_10000shares':float(paid),
      'original_received_cny_10000shares':float(received),'actual_export_path':bool(r.actual_added_path)})
diag=pd.DataFrame(rows)
main=diag[diag.era=='2024—2025'].copy();early=diag[diag.era=='2021—2023'].copy()
assert len(main)==10 and len(early)==22
net=main.saved_net5.to_numpy(float);gross=main.fixed_endpoints_raw_zero_cost_return.to_numpy(float)
positive=net[net>0]
best=int(np.argmax(net));maxrow=main.iloc[best]
rest=np.delete(net,best)
signalcounts={str(int(k)):int(v) for k,v in main.signal_year.value_counts().sort_index().items()}
entrycounts={str(int(k)):int(v) for k,v in main.entry_year.value_counts().sort_index().items()}
start=pd.Timestamp('2024-01-01');end=pd.to_datetime(main.exit_date).max()
days=int(d.date.between(start,end).sum())
assert days>=485 and all(main.entry_date.sort_values().iloc[j]>=main.exit_date.sort_values().iloc[j-1] for j in range(1,len(main)))
hindsight_growth=float(np.prod(1+0.5*np.maximum(gross,0))-1)
same_all_growth=float(np.prod(1+0.5*gross)-1)
ceiling_cagr=float((1+hindsight_growth)**(242/days)-1)
same_cagr=float((1+same_all_growth)**(242/days)-1)
summary={'primary_events':10,'earlier_events':22,'primary_mean_saved_net5':float(net.mean()),
 'primary_mean_same_quotes_zero_commission':float(main.same_quotes_zero_commission_return.mean()),
 'primary_mean_fixed_endpoints_raw_zero_cost':float(gross.mean()),
 'primary_win_rate':float((net>0).mean()),'primary_sum_saved_net_labels':float(net.sum()),
 'primary_positive_label_sum':float(positive.sum()),'largest_positive_label_signal_date':maxrow.signal_date,
 'largest_positive_label':float(maxrow.saved_net5),
 'largest_positive_label_share_of_positive_label_sum':float(maxrow.saved_net5/positive.sum()),
 'largest_positive_label_ratio_to_total_net_label_sum':float(maxrow.saved_net5/net.sum()),
 'all_other_nine_mean_net5_ex_post_description_only':float(rest.mean()),
 'primary_signal_year_event_counts':signalcounts,'primary_entry_year_event_counts':entrycounts,
 '2026_is_partial_year_and_after_original_score_period':True,
 'original_primary_period_all_natural_events_retained':True,
 'full_risk_account_cycles_not_computed':True,
 'counterfactual_fixed_path_end_date':str(end.date()),'counterfactual_full_cash_and_holding_trading_days':days,
 'counterfactual_50pct_zero_cost_all_original_windows_growth':same_all_growth,
 'counterfactual_50pct_zero_cost_all_original_windows_cagr242':same_cagr,
 'counterfactual_hindsight_positive_only_50pct_zero_cost_growth':hindsight_growth,
 'counterfactual_hindsight_positive_only_50pct_zero_cost_cagr242':ceiling_cagr,
 'counterfactual_limit':'只对原10窗口/原端点完整持有路径；事后、可分份额、零费用、权益即时可再用、不实行ES/现金/停牌限制，非可执行账户/任意策略上界。',
 'fixed_path_hindsight_cagr_below_target10pct':ceiling_cagr<0.10}
assert summary['fixed_path_hindsight_cagr_below_target10pct']
diag.to_csv(OUT/'全部32原机会_费用与入场年归属.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
pd.DataFrame([{'basis':'信号年','year':int(k),'opportunities':v} for k,v in signalcounts.items()]+[
 {'basis':'入场年','year':int(k),'opportunities':v} for k,v in entrycounts.items()]).to_csv(OUT/'主期固定十机会_信号年与入场年.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
save_new('diagnostic_summary.json',summary)
r={'study_id':p27['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E27','completed_at':now(),
 'status':'COMPLETED_FIXED_EXPORT_OPPORTUNITY_GAP_CONCENTRATED_AND_INSUFFICIENT',
 'classification':'PROGRESS_E27_FIXED_EXPORT_OPPORTUNITIES_TARGET_GAP_AND_ENTRY_YEAR_DISTINGUISHED',
 'diagnostic':summary,'new_model_fits':0,'new_fits':0,'new_training_labels':0,'new_full_accounts':0,
 'new_source_requests':0,'source_code_edits':0,'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','goal_achieved':False,
 'account_status':'NOT_RUN_E26_FIXED_GATE_FAILED_DIAGNOSTICS_ONLY',
 'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,
 'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'independent_validation':'NOT_ESTABLISHED_ALREADY_OBSERVED_HISTORY',
 'E26_original_failure_and_all_events_preserved':True,
 'facts_report':R+'/固定十机会_目标缺口结论.md'}
save_new('result.json',r)
saved=pd.read_csv(OUT/'全部32原机会_费用与入场年归属.csv')
assert len(saved)==32 and np.allclose(saved.saved_net5.to_numpy(),diag.saved_net5.to_numpy(),rtol=0,atol=1e-15)
for x in parents:assert sha(ROOT/x['path'])==x['sha256']
save_new('保存结果必要核对.json',{'status':'PASS_ORIGINAL_32_LABEL_IDENTITIES_COST_ORDER_ENTRY_YEARS_AND_FIXED_BOUND',
 'parents_unchanged':len(parents),'original_events':32,'primary':10,'original_net_label_max_error':float(max(abs(diag.saved_net5.to_numpy()-saved.saved_net5.to_numpy()))),
 'primary_calendar_scope_extended_to_original_last_exit':True,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,
 'counterfactual_not_executable_and_not_general_upper_bound':True,'E26_frozen_gate_unchanged':True})
pct=lambda x:f'{x:.6%}'
report=f'''# E27：高分均值变正，距离完整目标还差什么

保留E26全部32原自然机会，主期10、较早22，不重新拟合、不删事件或改变持有规则。主期平均原净五日{pct(net.mean())}、胜率{pct((net>0).mean())}；正均值并不等于完整账户夏普或年化达到目标。

最大的正标签来自{maxrow.signal_date}，原净五日{pct(maxrow.saved_net5)}，占正标签总和{pct(summary['largest_positive_label_share_of_positive_label_sum'])}。其余九行平均{pct(rest.mean())}只用于事后贡献描述，不能作为删样本策略，也不是实际账户利润占比。

原评分期按信号日定义仍2024—2025；信号年计数{signalcounts}，按合同入场年为{entrycounts}。2025-12-31信号实际2026-01-05入场，不能计作2025周期，2026为残年。2024只有3次自然机会，尚未执行风险账户，不能把机会当已完成账户周期。E26原逐年文件按信号年，不能直接裁决入场年合同频率。

同原报价只返佣金，平均收益为{pct(summary['primary_mean_same_quotes_zero_commission'])}；原始开盘端点零佣金/零滑点含权益平均{pct(gross.mean())}。所有32标签都按原10000份/佣金/报价/登记权益精确复算，原标签不变。

仅对原10个固定完整持有窗口，零费用、每次起点50%NAV、可分份额且忽略现实预算/现金等限制，原全部窗口的端点财富增长{pct(same_all_growth)}、242日年化{pct(same_cagr)}。再允许事后完美跳过非正原始收益窗口，有限路径财富增长{pct(hindsight_growth)}、年化{pct(ceiling_cagr)}；从2024首交易日至原最后退出{str(end.date())}，全现金日含在{days}个交易日中。这个事后宽松上界仍低于10%，不能执行，也不能推广到不同窗口、中途退出或任意策略。

因此，E26的正均值改善值得如实保留，但收益来源集中、2024机会不足，原固定路径靠降低费用也不足以达到年化目标。原五项增量门未过及所有失败保持；不修改高分、出口字段、模型或年份营救。全账户/夏普NOT_COMPUTED、目标未完成。

[协议](protocol.json)、[全部32原机会费用/年份](全部32原机会_费用与入场年归属.csv)、[主期两种年份](主期固定十机会_信号年与入场年.csv)、[完整诊断](diagnostic_summary.json)、[结果](result.json)、[必要核对](保存结果必要核对.json)。
'''
(OUT/'固定十机会_目标缺口结论.md').write_text(report,encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'E27':'已完成原机会目标缺口','主期净均值':float(net.mean()),
 '最大正标签占正贡献':summary['largest_positive_label_share_of_positive_label_sum'],
 '其余九行净均值':float(rest.mean()),'按实际入场年':entrycounts,
 '同原始端点零费用完美跳过半仓年化上界':ceiling_cagr,'新拟合':0,'新账户':0,'目标':False},ensure_ascii=False))
